title: A Very Greenland Graduation
description: A traditional high school graduation ceremony takes place in Nuuk, Greenland. In western Greenland, students wear a white captain's hat and one of the country's national costumes when partaking in the ceremony. While the men wear white seal-skin anoraks, the women's costumes in this part of the country are called kalaallisuut; both are typically reserved for special occasions including religious or national events. Kalaallisuut are known for being colorful, with intricate glass bead collars, sealskin short pants, and decorated white boots known as kamiit. This photograph is featured in Daniel Dorsa's latest book, To Skip a Sinking Stone, where he documents his visits to Greenland over the years. He refers to the country as "a place caught between preservation and transformation, where ancient rhythms meet new realities."
translated_description: 格陵兰岛努克市举行了一场传统高中毕业典礼。在西格陵兰地区，学生们参加典礼时会佩戴白色船长帽，并身着该国民族服饰。当地男性穿着白色海豹皮风雪大衣，而女性服饰则被称为"卡莱利苏特"——这类服装通常只在宗教或国家庆典等特殊场合穿着。卡莱利苏特以色彩绚丽著称，配有精致的玻璃珠领饰、海豹皮短裤，以及名为"卡米特"的装饰性白色靴子。这张照片收录于丹尼尔·多萨的新书《跳过沉石》，记录了他多年来在格陵兰岛的见闻。他将这个国家称为"一个在守护与变革之间徘徊的地方，古老韵律在此与崭新现实相遇"。
